title: School Gardens
passage: Many schools in Japan have gardens. Students grow vegetables and flowers there. Some students like taking care of plants, so they join the gardening club after school.
pictureAlt: A school garden. A girl is watering flowers. Three birds are sitting on the fence. Tomato plants grow on the right.

questions.text: Please look at the passage. Why do some students join the gardening club after school?
questions.tip: パッセージの “so” の前を探そう。“Because they …” で答えよう。
questions.model: Because they like taking care of plants.

questions.text: Please look at the picture. How many birds are there on the fence?
questions.tip: 数を数えて “There are …” で答えよう。

questions.text: What do you like to do on weekends?
questions.tip: 自分のことを答えよう。“I like to …” で文で言おう。
questions.model: I like to play soccer with my friends.

questions.tip: まず Yes か No で答えよう。
questions.model: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

followYes.tip: もう1文、くわしく言おう。
followYes.model: I often make curry with my mother.

followNo.model: Because it is difficult for me.
